name: Quality

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
      agents_sha: ${{ steps.agents.outputs.sha }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Resolve dmtools-agents SHA once per run (gh-437)
        # Every job of this run fetches agents at THIS commit, so the
        # agents-gate partition check cannot race with a commit landing
        # on agents main mid-run. Outputs persist across attempts, so a
        # rerun of a failed job reuses the same SHA.
        id: agents
        run: |
          SHA=$(git ls-remote https://github.com/IstiN/dmtools-agents.git refs/heads/main | cut -f1)
          [[ "$SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]] || { echo "::error::cannot resolve dmtools-agents main"; exit 1; }
          echo "sha=$SHA" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "### dmtools-agents SHA: \`${SHA:0:12}\`" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          echo "[quality] dmtools-agents pinned for this run: $SHA"
      - name: Canary the Bitrise pool, else fall back to GitHub-hosted
        id: pick
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v gh >/dev/null || { sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq gh; }
          TS=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
          gh workflow run bitrise-probe.yml --ref "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" || true
          VERDICT=no-pickup
          RUNNER=ubuntu-24.04
          for i in $(seq 1 9); do
            sleep 10
            R=$(gh run list --workflow bitrise-probe.yml --created ">$TS" \
                 --limit 1 --json status,conclusion \
                 --jq '.[0] | "\(.status)/\(.conclusion // "-")"' 2>/dev/null || echo none)
            case "$R" in
              completed/success) VERDICT=pool-up;   RUNNER=bitrise-runner-dmtools-ci; break ;;
              completed/*)       VERDICT=pool-red;  break ;;
            esac
          done
          echo "runner=$RUNNER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "picker: $VERDICT -> $RUNNER"

  static:
    # Fast lane: format + analyze need no toolchain (gcc/QuickJS) — they
    # finish in ~2 min and fail the pipeline early on style/type errors.
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - run: dart format --set-exit-if-changed .
      - run: dart analyze

  test:
    # The suite (~2.3k tests) is sharded 4 ways — wall time drops from
    # ~17 min serial to ~5-6 min (fixed per-shard overhead ~3 min +
    # suite/4). Each shard uploads its partial lcov + test count; the
    # gate job merges them. Bitrise pool first (owner 2026-10-15): the
    # 4-shard suite is the wall-time pole — same dispatch shape as the
    # agents-suite below; falls back to ubuntu-24.04 when the pool is down.
    needs: pick
    runs-on: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.runner }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3]
    env:
      TOTAL_SHARDS: 4
    steps:
      - name: Runner disk hygiene
        # Bitrise pool machines accumulate per-run workdirs; twice on
        # 2026-09-26 a full disk killed agents-suite mid-run. Drop stale
        # dirs (>1 day) before checkout. Never touches the current
        # workspace; fresh mtimes protect concurrently running jobs.
        run: |
          df -h / || true
          WS_PARENT="$(dirname "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          CUR="$(basename "$RUNNER_WORKSPACE")"
          find "$WS_PARENT" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d ! -name "$CUR" -mtime +1 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
          find "$WS_PARENT/_temp" -mindepth 1 -mtime +1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
          df -h / || true
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Fetch dmtools-agents (run SHA, no submodule pin)
        env:
          AGENTS_FETCH_REF: ${{ needs.pick.outputs.agents_sha }}
        run: bash tool/fetch_agents.sh
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install gcc
        run: |
          # apt hung twice on 2026-08-19 (no exit — jobs burned 19+ minutes on
          # this step before manual cancellation). Cap each attempt and retry
          # so a flaky mirror fails the job fast instead of stalling it.
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            if timeout 300 sudo apt-get update -qq && \
               timeout 300 sudo apt-get install -y -qq gcc; then
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "apt attempt $attempt failed or timed out; retrying in 15s"
            sudo dpkg --configure -a || true
            sleep 15
          done
          echo "apt failed after 3 attempts"
          exit 1
      - name: Build QuickJS (quickjs_runtime package)
        run: |
          PKG=$(python3 -c "import json;print([p['rootUri'] for p in json.load(open('.dart_tool/package_config.json'))['packages'] if p['name']=='quickjs_runtime'][0].replace('file://',''))")
          bash "$PKG/tool/build_quickjs.sh"
      - name: dart test (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/${{ env.TOTAL_SHARDS }}) --coverage
        id: test
        # pipefail keeps a red shard red through the tee; the captured count
        # feeds the badges step (summed across shards in the gate job).
        # --reporter compact: on CI dart test auto-selects the github
        # reporter, which has no +N counters and would leave COUNT empty
        # (grep exits 1, bash -e kills the step).
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          dart test --coverage=coverage --reporter compact \
            --total-shards "$TOTAL_SHARDS" --shard-index "${{ matrix.shard }}" \
            2>&1 | tee /tmp/test_run.log
          COUNT=$(grep -oE '\+[0-9]+' /tmp/test_run.log | tail -1 | tr -d '+' || true)
          echo "test_count=${COUNT:-0}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: dart pub global activate coverage
      - name: Format coverage (shard)

# gh-440: Quality: wedged test shard holds the merge slot for hours — job-level timeout + stall-log capture (test (3) froze twice, per-test 30s timeout never fired)

## Description

## Goal — a wedged Quality shard must die on a bounded timeout and leave its stall evidence behind (v1)
One sentence: **each `test` shard job in quality.yml carries a job-level `timeout-minutes` and uploads its compact-reporter log on failure, so a synchronously-wedged test isolate is killed and identified in minutes instead of holding the serial pre-merge slot for hours.**

## Live evidence
- 2026-10-19 18:28 — run 39301703682 attempt 1, shard `test (3)`, frozen at `confluence_restore_page` (+743, no progress 19 min; I cancelled manually).
- 2026-10-20 05:25 — run 39374625906, shard `test (3)`, frozen at `jira_search_with_pagination with offset` (+668, minute-keepalive lines only, 85+ min; cancelled manually).
- Both times: dart test's default 30s per-test timeout NEVER fired while the compact reporter kept re-printing the current test every minute. That signature means the test isolate is wedged in a synchronous (non-yielding) loop — timers cannot fire — while the runner isolate stays alive. The hung test differs between occurrences; both are `test/integrations/*` tool-executor tests, i.e. simply where the freeze lands in that shard's tail.
- Both heads differ (59027560, fe54dffd); the Jira/Confluence executors are pure Dart and do not touch the async-pool/require-loader code the PRs change. After a manual cancel+rerun yesterday the same shard passed in 8 minutes.
- After cancel, the job log is purged (BlobNotFound) — the stall evidence vanished with it.

## Architecture
1. `quality.yml`: the `test` matrix job gets `timeout-minutes: 45` (normal shard ≈ 8–20 min). Same for `agents-suite` shards.
2. The `dart test` step already `tee`s `/tmp/test_run.log`; add an `if: failure()` step that appends the last 100 lines of `/tmp/test_run.log` to `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` and uploads the full log as an artifact (name `test-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-log`).
3. Non-goal (separate issue if wanted): VM-level all-stack dump on stall (`--enable-vm-service` + watchdog) — valuable but heavier.

Invariants:
- I1 — a red-from-timeout shard is rerun-able like any failure (rerun-cancelled-checks path already exists).
- I2 — green-path logging unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria
- **AC1** — a shard job that exceeds 45 min is killed by the runner with `Job timed out` and the run goes red (IT: dispatch with a `sleep` canary test on a scratch branch).
- **AC2** — the timed-out job's step summary contains the last reporter lines naming the stuck test (AC via the same canary).
- **AC3** — the log artifact exists for the timed-out job.
- **AC4** — normal green runs are byte-identical (no extra steps fire).

Quality runs 39301703682 (attempt 1) and 39374625906 job `test (3)` (id 118470331970); epam/dmtools-dart#433.

# Dispatch-only CI (2026-09 machine-loop redesign): pushes fire NO CI —
# the SM (machine-sm.yml → factory-sm) is the only trigger. It dispatches
# this workflow on the PR head when validation is due (sm rule
# validate-fresh / validate-armed), so intermediate dev/rework pushes and
# silent branch updates are free. Required checks still match: the
# dispatched run registers its check runs on the head SHA.
# Main keeps its push CI (badges + history).
on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  # PR branches: a fresh dispatch supersedes the in-flight run. Main keeps
  # every run (badges + history).
  group: quality-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}

jobs:
  pick:
    # Bitrise-first picker (owner 2026-10-13): the pool is preferred, but a
    # dead/paused pool must never park the machine on "queued forever".
    # Canary: dispatch the short-capped pool probe and poll briefly; the
    # probe answering fast = pool alive -> pool. Any other outcome (no
    # pickup within the window, red, dispatch failure) -> GitHub-hosted.
    # Worst-case added latency when the pool is down: ~90s once per run.
    # ubuntu-slim: separate hosted capacity class — the picker must not
    # queue behind heavy ubuntu-latest load (fa release validations etc.);
    # it only runs gh calls (~90s).
    runs-on: ubuntu-slim
    outputs:
      runner: ${{ steps.pick.outputs.runner }}
      agents_sha: ${{ steps.agents.outputs.sha }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Resolve dmtools-agents SHA once per run (gh-437)
        # Every job of this run fetches agents at THIS commit, so the
        # agents-gate partition check cannot race with a commit landing
        # on agents main mid-run. Outputs persist across attempts, so a
        # rerun of a failed job reuses the same SHA.
        id: agents
